caveats: zbb_bench is a best case, made of the code these extensions are for; the gain on ordinary code is much smaller.
The std objects are built for rv32i in every variant (GCC 12.2 crashes on std/src/helperfunctions.c with Zbs); they only print, outside the timed windows.
The cycles are those of the Verilator model of the RTL of this working tree; the RTL has not been implemented on an FPGA since the change.
